# Feature: Web Doctor

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #14 -->

## Intent
A run that dies after eight minutes of build because Chrome is missing wastes trust. Doctor checks Node, browser binary, port, and start command, and reports expected version plus inspected paths (FR-005, FR-006).

Roadmap: Epic 2 Web CLI.

## Preconditions
- CLI entrypoint (#11) and discovery (#12) exist
- Playwright is a workspace e2e dependency

## Happy Path
- [ ] `potato doctor <root>` prints checks as `ok` / `missing` / `unsupported` with inspected paths
- [ ] Successful doctor against the web fixture (injected healthy browser) exits 0
- [ ] Missing required capability makes `potato run` exit 3, not 1
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Doctor does not execute the start command (argv listed only)
- [ ] Occupied app port is reported with a path/detail, does not by itself use exit 1
- [ ] Unknown repo can report `start-command` as missing

## Regression
- [ ] `potato init` without `--confirm` still writes nothing
- [ ] `pnpm checks` does not require a Playwright browser download
- [ ] Scope: `packages/adapter-web/**`, `packages/cli/**` — no dashboard

## Assumptions
- Browser locator is injected so unit tests do not need `playwright install`
- Node version below 24 is reported in detail but not a missing required capability (CI is 24; local may be 22)
- Default app port is 5199 (fixture e2e bind)

## Security Coverage
- B-04: start command is never executed; argv arrays only
- P-02: doctor output is check ids/paths/details, no stack traces
- P-04: N/A (no writes)
- F-03: no secrets

## Screenshots
Not applicable (CLI).

## Implementation Notes
- New package `packages/adapter-web`: `runWebDoctor` checks node, browser, start-command, port.
- Status union is `ok | missing | unsupported`; MVP checks emit `ok`/`missing` only (`unsupported` reserved).
- Browser locator and port probe are injected (`DoctorEnv`) so `pnpm checks` does not need `playwright install`.
- Start argv is inferred via `startArgv(kinds)` and never executed.
- Occupied port is `ok` (not required); missing required check blocks `potato run` with exit 3.
- CLI `doctor` prints TSV lines (`id`, `status`, `path`, `detail`) plus `doctor: ok|blocked`.
- 72 tests; `pnpm checks` green.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE (uncommitted issue/14-web-doctor)
- Event: developer runs `potato doctor` or `potato run` against a project root.
- Hop chain: CLI → detectProject → runWebDoctor → DoctorReport → stdout/stderr + exit code.
- Cardinality: one invocation → one report → one exit. Missing required capability fails closed (exit 3); busy port does not.
- No queue, worker, persist, or fan-out.
